name: nightmarquee
description: Ask the Cursor agent for a landing page or hero section and it finds a cinematic design, fetches the build prompt written for Cursor and downloads a runnable starter where one exists. You can also check any public site for AI-look problems and get fixes to paste. Search and free designs need no account; footage, starters and the site check need a free account, and the other designs need a plan. Cursor opens the sign-in the first time it is needed.
